title: Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Slovakian-inspired pork skewer recipe, perfect for a quick dinner. The combination of pork, vegetables, and spices will transport your taste buds to Eastern Europe.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Use a meat thermometer to ensure the pork reaches a safe internal temperature of 63°C (145°F)

ingredients.name: Bell peppers, any color, sliced
ingredients.notes: You can use any color bell pepper you like or have on hand

ingredients.name: Onions, sliced
ingredients.notes: You can use red or yellow onions for this recipe

ingredients.name: Tomatoes, cherry, halved
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of tomato you like or have on hand

ingredients.name: Skewers, metal or bamboo
ingredients.notes: Make sure the skewers are clean and dry before using

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt or kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Use sweet or smoked paprika for this recipe

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor

instructions: 1. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (about 200°C or 400°F).
2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
3. Add the pork cubes, bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes to the bowl. Toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread the pork and vegetables onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork reaches a safe internal temperature of 63°C (145°F).
6. While the skewers are cooking, mix the minced garlic with a little bit of olive oil. Brush the garlic mixture onto the skewers during the last minute of cooking.
7. Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
8. Serve the Slovakian pork skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill if desired.
